name: Office Library · No. 7 · Moby-Dick, Rockwell Kent, 1930
description:
Who might like it: anyone who likes a job that gets out of hand. Half adventure, half someone explaining their hobby at length. Both halves are good. No spoilers.

Rockwell Kent's whale from the 1930 illustrated edition, public domain in the United States, image via Wikimedia Commons, with an Office Noun from the official CC0 Nouns traits added to the water. It is not helping. Made by the Office Noun X desk. Free edition. Published by officenoun.tez.
